description: This file defines the internal radix tree (rtree) data structure used in jemalloc for associating metadata with memory extents. It includes structure definitions, macros, inline functions for accessing and manipulating rtree elements, and function prototypes for rtree operations.

classes.name: rtree_node_elm_t
classes.description: Structure representing a node element in the radix tree, containing an atomic pointer to a child node or leaf.

classes.name: rtree_leaf_elm_t
classes.description: Structure representing a leaf element in the radix tree, containing metadata such as extent, size index, and slab flag, with support for compact representation.

classes.name: rtree_level_t
classes.description: Structure representing a level in the radix tree, with bit width and cumulative bits.

classes.name: rtree_t
classes.description: Main radix tree structure containing a mutex lock and root elements, with variable height based on address bits.

methods.name: rtree_new
methods.description: Initializes a new radix tree, optionally zeroed.

methods.name: rtree_delete
methods.description: Deletes the radix tree, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: rtree_leaf_elm_lookup_hard
methods.description: Performs a hard lookup for a leaf element in the radix tree based on a key.

methods.name: rtree_leafkey
methods.description: Computes the leaf key from a virtual address key.

methods.name: rtree_cache_direct_map
methods.description: Maps a key directly to a cache slot index.

methods.name: rtree_subkey
methods.description: Extracts the subkey for a given level in the radix tree from a key.

methods.name: rtree_write
methods.description: Associates an extent and metadata with a key in the radix tree.

methods.name: rtree_read
methods.description: Reads the leaf element associated with a key.

methods.name: rtree_extent_read
methods.description: Reads the extent pointer associated with a key.

methods.name: rtree_szind_read
methods.description: Reads the size index associated with a key.

methods.name: rtree_extent_szind_read
methods.description: Reads both extent and size index for a key.

methods.name: rtree_szind_slab_read_fast
methods.description: Fast path to read size index and slab flag from cache.

methods.name: rtree_szind_slab_read
methods.description: Reads size index and slab flag for a key.

methods.name: rtree_szind_slab_update
methods.description: Updates size index and slab flag for a key.

methods.name: rtree_clear
methods.description: Clears the extent associated with a key.
